elements.name: Authenticated user
elements.description: A user manages only their own lists and tasks.

elements.name: Todo Web Client
elements.description: Calls the JSON API over HTTPS.

elements.name: Todo API
elements.description: Validates bearer identity and exposes task CRUD endpoints.

elements.name: PostgreSQL Adapter
elements.description: Persists lists and tasks in a transaction.

elements.name: TodoController
elements.description: HTTP boundary: GET /lists/{id}/todos; POST; PATCH /todos/{id}; DELETE /todos/{id}.

elements.name: TodoService
elements.description: Checks ownership and coordinates CRUD transactions.

elements.name: TodoRepository
elements.description: Persistence contract used by application service.

elements.name: PostgresTodoRepository
elements.description: Implements the repository using parameterized SQL.

elements.name: TodoList
elements.description: Named collection belonging to an account.

elements.name: Todo
elements.description: A task can be open, completed, reopened or archived.

elements.name: CreateTodoRequest
elements.description: Request DTO with title and listId.

elements.name: TodoResponse
elements.description: Response DTO with identity, title and completion status.

elements.name: Create todo
elements.description: POST validates title, checks list ownership and returns 201 with the persisted Todo.

elements.name: List todos
elements.description: GET returns only tasks in a list owned by the caller.

elements.name: Complete or reopen todo
elements.description: PATCH updates title or completed with optimistic version checking.

elements.name: Delete todo
elements.description: DELETE archives the task and returns 204; unknown or foreign IDs return 404.

elements.name: Recovery workflow
elements.description: Independent compensation behavior; never a submachine of Archived.
